key.name: ui-mode
key.description: Where the server indicator lives. "quick-settings" adds a tile inside GNOME's Quick Settings panel (like Wi-Fi or Bluetooth). "panel" adds a classic top-bar icon with a popup menu.

key.name: port
key.description: TCP port the dashboard server listens on. The environment variable AGENT_WORKSPACE_PORT, if set, overrides this value.

key.name: show-when-stopped
key.summary: Show indicator when the server is stopped
key.description: If on, the top-bar icon stays visible (dimmed) when the server is not running. If off, the icon hides entirely while stopped.
